supersession_reason: v1 rejected selected annotation products linked to multiple coordinate rows. v2 preserves every such link and labels its coordinate-anchor multiplicity.
scope: For every frozen manifest taxon, export every immutable gene-coordinate row as a disposition and every selected representative product link as a coordinate anchor. Product links with multiple coordinate anchors remain explicit. These are source annotation mappings, not orthology, HOG membership, synteny, duplication, or evolutionary-event calls.
